messages:
Mia: Quick heads-up — collected a batch of feature asks & pain notes from four accounts during onboarding check-ins today. Figured we should triage before next PLG sprint so CS can close the loop. TL;DR: embed routing, per-route cost visibility, and a large docs/UX gap on embeddings refresh.
Devon: Can you paste the raw list here or gdoc? Need to map to product themes + estimated effort.
Mia: Pasted a short CSV snippet in the thread and uploaded the full sheet to /drive: https://drive.redwood/example (private link)
Mia: ```account,ask,impact,reported_by
Orion Health,per-route billing toggle,high,onboarding
Leafly,embedding staleness in search,medium,renewal
SummitHealth,streaming latency spikes,high,trial
Bento,admin-level role controls,low,implementation
```
Jorge: Heads-up on SummitHealth — renewal flagged if latency not mitigated. They're on Dedicated and very sensitive to p95. Mark that as "renewal risk" in the triage.
Alyssa: Thanks. From product side — can you add: expected user journey, how often they hit embeddings refresh, and any repro steps? That helps with prioritization vs quick wins.
Mia: Added a notes column in the sheet. For Leafly: embeddings refresh roughly daily, search degradation after large catalog syncs. SummitHealth has a reproducible tail during 200–400 token streams.
Devon: Proposed grouping for prioritization: 1) Renewal risk (SummitHealth latency) 2) High onboarding blockers (Orion per-route billing toggle) 3) Platform quality (embedding refresh) 4) Low-effort UX (admin roles)
Alyssa: I can scope SummitHealth perf triage — will run our profiling checklist and sync with eng-runtime. Can we get request ids/sample traces? @Mia
Mia: Yes — I'll pull traces and drop them in the sheet under "traces" column. Also adding a short repro curl for SummitHealth sample:
Mia: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"<long chat>","stream":true}'
# observe p95 in response stream and X-Redwood-KV-Cache headers
```
ops-bot: New upload detected: "account-asks-Apr-2026.csv" by Mia. (automated)
Jorge: For renewal playbook: CS to offer a canary of reduced batch size + warm KV caching, and product to scope quantization knobs. If Summit still sees issues, escalate to Dedicated infra for capacity bump.
Devon: Suggested labels for tracker: [renewal-risk], [onboard-blocker], [perf], [low-effort]. I'll create JIRA tickets for top 3 and link to the sheet.
Alyssa: Please include acceptance criteria: e.g., p95 < 250ms for 95th percentile workload or documented fallback path.
Mia: Putting acceptance criteria and expected customers in the sheet now. Also scheduling a 30m sync Friday for handoff (CS + Product + Eng-runtime). Who can join?
Devon: I can. Alyssa? Jorge?
Alyssa: I'll be there. Jorge: yes.
Mia: Cool — calendar invite sent. Thanks team. I'll DM SummitHealth about the mitigation plan and follow up in thread after the Friday sync. :thumbsup:
